items.reason: A rinse-off wash you already chose that suits oily-looking skin and is fine to keep, used briefly and gently.
A simple barrier moisturizer to offset dryness and keep skin comfortable alongside the wash.
A mineral SPF helps keep the look of marks from appearing darker in the sun.

response.routine_note: Big painful lumps that leave marks are best looked at by a dermatologist, and nothing in a shop is a substitute, so please book a visit rather than reaching for the strongest product; I removed the 30% peel because it is far too harsh for this skin and could leave it sore and more marked-looking. In the meantime, use the wash once a day on damp skin and rinse well, then moisturizer, and SPF every morning.
